title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, information exposure, supply constraints, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe peers’ mask use and update their own propensity to wear masks via social norms and peer pressure.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: Media broadcasts information or misinformation affecting individuals’ risk perception and perceived effectiveness of masks.

interactions.name: policy_announcement
interactions.description: Government issues recommendations or mandates that shift baseline compliance and trigger enforcement.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities check compliance and apply warnings/fines, influencing future behavior.

interactions.name: location_attendance
interactions.description: People visit workplaces and public spaces, encounter norms and enforcement, and generate social contacts.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to price and availability; stock dynamics can constrain adoption.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Households shape member norms through repeated interactions at home.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days required for mask adoption to reach 70% of the population for the first time.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_at_horizon
metrics.description: Adoption rate on the final simulation day (or average over the last N days).

metrics.name: compliance_by_location
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rates observed in workplaces and public spaces.

metrics.name: masks_purchased
metrics.description: Total number of masks bought from retailers.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer stockouts affecting purchase attempts.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality of adoption across socioeconomic groups (e.g., Gini coefficient).

metrics.name: policy_effect_increment
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy shifts (pre/post intervention delta).

validation_criteria.name: target_adoption_threshold
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate reaches at least 70% within the simulation horizon under strong mandate scenarios.

validation_criteria.name: stability_after_horizon
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate variance over the last 14 days is below a small threshold, indicating dynamic stability.

validation_criteria.name: replicate_consistency
validation_criteria.description: Across multiple random seeds, key metrics (e.g., final adoption) vary by less than 5% absolute.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_rmse_optional
validation_criteria.description: If observed adoption data are available, RMSE between simulated and observed adoption trajectory falls below a predefined threshold.
